review.summary: The plan references several modules, services, and data models that are not currently grounded in the system_state.json or repo files.

findings.title: Ungrounded module reference: messaging
findings.evidence: The artifact references 'messaging' as a supported module without evidence it exists in the current system_state.json.
findings.requiredAction: Remove or ground the 'messaging' module reference to existing repo files.

findings.title: Future-state services not grounded: enforcement, workflow areas
findings.evidence: The artifact mentions moving towards modular separation for enforcement and workflow areas without evidence of these modules in system_state.json.
findings.requiredAction: Define concrete implementation details or remove references to future services that are not yet grounded.

findings.title: Future-state data models not grounded: multi-org, client-visibility requirements
findings.evidence: The artifact mentions schema alignment with multi-org and client-visibility requirements without evidence of these data models in system_state.json.
findings.requiredAction: Define concrete implementation details or remove references to future data models that are not yet grounded.

verificationChecks: Validate module and service existence against repo files

requiredAction: Escalate to Copilot for manual intervention beyond Dr Bob auto-fix scope.
